rationale: Linear dependency chain: validator must exist (A) before producers can call it (B), and producer wrapping must land before CI can flip to fail-closed strict mode (C), and the final test count is needed for CHANGELOG/version (D). Parallelism only inside groups B and C.

groups.description: Validator extension + buildOutboxRow factory + per-rule unit tests. No producer changes.

Route 11 producer call-sites through buildEnvelope / buildOutboxRow. S2 covers 7 via the appendSystemMailbox chokepoint; S3 covers the remaining 4 individually. Internally parallelizable (different files).

Flip CREWS_STRICT_SCHEMA=1 in tests/run.js (S4), add round-trip contract tests per producer/consumer pair (S5), add v1.7.2 summary-drop regression test (S6, can fold into S5 commit). S5 and S6 are independent of S4 ordering.
Documentation updates (docs/protocol.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md), version bump via scripts/bump-version.js 2.3.0, optional GitHub Actions workflow (stretch, operator-confirmed).

notes: Dependency chain is shallow; serial implementation is also fine.

Risk R1 (existing producer tests with malformed envelopes) may surface during S4; the impl member should backport any real-bug fixes to S2/S3 and add per-test opt-outs for intentional-malformed-input tests.
Stretch goal in S7 (.github/workflows/crews-tests.yml) is operator-opt-in only.
Out-of-scope follow-ups already seeded by the brainstorm: crews-envelope-summary-canonical-cleanup, crews-envelope-replyto-field-name-unification, crews-envelope-kind-routing-rename.
